values: 90 of 180 runs complete. Seed 60. One trial per configuration; no statistical error bars.
4x4 mesh; 16 data slots/core, initially 14 occupied; 224 logical qubits. Communication memories are separate.
XY and History are generated from the same frozen placement transitions for each benchmark. History capacity reference is 4 for both memory studies.
Mapping seed 42; physics seed 60. Physical entity seeding uses 4 reference memories across all cases.
Main layer planner: 1-8 active-layer lookback, asynchronous refill, demand guard, ready-first then longest-chain priority, 10 ns empty layers.
Eight total / six compiler memories and four total / three compiler memories. Generation launch budget equals physical memories per core per layer.
Starts at 256 physical and compiler memories/core. Verify peak booked-plus-outstanding demand and planner storage remain below capacity. Otherwise not reported as unlimited.

Autonomous cache: 2 of 4 slots or 3 of 8 slots; existing physical swap adoption retained. Admission now recognizes generic cached pairs and wakes when a pair becomes ready. This is a revised configuration, not the old 3-of-4 run.
Mean eligibility-to-physical-EPR-delivery latency per adjacent routed hop, including admission wait. Later chain hops become eligible after their predecessor completes.
End-to-end simulated workload duration, including layer timing. Not physical wall time spent computing the simulation.
Mean delivered physical EPR fidelity across completed hop requests. CD utilization fidelity covers compiler-generated pairs only.
Ready-at-submit availability: fraction of all hop requests with a cached pair before first application submission. Does not guarantee that the pair was ultimately adopted.
Actual compiler-pair uses whose physical creation precedes first application submission, divided by all hop requests.
Study observers canonicalize physical memory pairs across both endpoints; generation/use/expiry/remaining are not endpoint counters. ODG-only pairs are not cached and are excluded from cache wastage.
Successfully generated cached pairs removed by reservation expiry or physical memory decoherence. Failed generation attempts are not expired pairs.
Generated cached pairs still present when the workload ends. These are not counted as expired.
No separate cache eviction operation is implemented by these policies. Recorded expiry and consumption are classified separately.
(Expired + unused at finish + evicted) / successfully generated cached pairs. No generated pairs means not applicable, not zero waste.
1 - strategy mean latency / matching ODG mean latency, same benchmark, routing and memory count. CD unlimited is compared to ODG-8 and is not a same-resource comparison.
Physical SeQUeNCe EPR generation, memory coherence and reservation protocols. No data teleportation, data-memory occupancy, or computational gate/reset timing is simulated.
One seed per case as requested. Differences are observations, not evidence of statistical significance.
Pending cells are unavailable, not zero. Final output requires all 180 completed runs with no physical audit violations.
Committed benchmarks/manifest.json and benchmarks/README.md; MQT Bench 2.3.0, 224-qubit QASM files.
